properties.displayName: SCF - Manual Attestation for Production and Non-Production Segregation
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to ensure that Production and Non-Production environments are segregated through the use of virtual network segmentation, dedicated identities, dedicated service principals, and CSP subscriptions.
